user_question: 最近 1–2 天大盘下跌, 会不会使结论偏负?
short_answer: 会 (部分). 短窗口负 EV 仍足以阻止当前自动 probe (因为正 EV 路径需要 zero_il_lvr + 高 fee, 而 zero_il_lvr 不现实). 但长期判断需要 regime split, 不能在单一 regime snapshot 下结论.

downtrend_specific_impacts.impact: net_ev 更负. heuristic 0.5%/day 可能低估 IL. 实际 V3 CL 跨 tick boundary 增加 IL.
下跌时 active LP 减少, 滑点 higher, quote 实际更差
gross fee 减少, 实际 0.5%/day turnover 可能高估
snapshot 是单 regime, 不能外推到其他 regime
短窗口负 EV 仍足以 STOP. 任何 IL > 0 → 全负, 不依赖 regime.

boundary_meaning.current_short_window_reject: sufficient for STOP decision (auto probe blocked)

regime_categories.name: uptrend
regime_categories.description: 持续 positive price action, volume 上升
regime_categories.lp_impact: 池 active liquidity 上升, fee velocity 上升, IL 也上升
regime_categories.reopen_priority: HIGH (上行 + fee velocity = 可能正 EV)

regime_categories.name: downtrend
regime_categories.description: 持续 negative price action, volume 略低
regime_categories.lp_impact: 池 active liquidity 下降, fee velocity 可能下降, IL 高
regime_categories.reopen_priority: LOW (本次 snapshot 就是 downtrend, 结论已 reject)

regime_categories.name: sideways
regime_categories.description: 价格区间, 无明显 trend
regime_categories.lp_impact: 池 active liquidity 稳定, fee velocity 取决于 volume
regime_categories.reopen_priority: MEDIUM (sideways 是 LP 最 common regime)

regime_categories.name: high_volume_sideways
regime_categories.lp_impact: fee velocity 最高, IL 低 (sideways), 最适合 LP
regime_categories.reopen_priority: HIGH (如果该 regime 持续, LP EV 可能正)

regime_categories.name: high_volatility_trend
regime_categories.lp_impact: fee velocity 高, IL 也高

regime_categories.name: incentive_period
regime_categories.description: 协议有 LM 奖励, bribe, IFO 等待
regime_categories.lp_impact: real yield = fee + LM + bribe, 可能 fee 的 5-10×
regime_categories.reopen_priority: HIGH (如果协议有 active LM, LP 可能正)

regime_categories.name: low_volatility_stable
regime_categories.description: 价格几乎不动 (如 stablecoin pair)
regime_categories.lp_impact: fee velocity 极低, IL 极低
regime_categories.reopen_priority: LOW (本研究 stable V1 已 reject)

regime_split_reopen_flow: 1. 收集历史 regime 数据 (90d / 365d)
2. 分类每个 regime 的 5 AMM protocols
3. 在每个 regime 下跑 EV model
4. regime 4 (high volume sideways) + regime 6 (incentive period) 是 best case
5. regime 2 (downtrend) + regime 7 (low vol stable) 是 worst case
6. 只有在 best case regime 下 positive_realistic > 0, 才考虑重开
7. worst case regime 必须 re-verify 5/5 reject 仍然 valid
downtrend_bias_reason: 本研究 snapshot (2026-06-04) 在 downtrend 环境下, IL/LVR proxy 偏高, fee velocity 可能偏低
downtrend_bias_implication: 短窗口结论对 current regime auto probe 充分, 对 long-term LP value 不充分
downtrend_bias_next_action: regime split 验证 (Stage F long_horizon_reopen_plan)
important_caveat: 下跌 bias 不是 5/5 reject 结论的弱点. STOP 决策在 downtrend 下仍 valid. 下跌 bias 是长期 LP 价值判断的不充分理由. regime split 验证是 Stage F long_horizon_reopen_plan 的核心.
conclusion_rescope: 本研究的结论, 在 'current data + current model + current regime (downtrend 1-2 天) + retail 10/20U 2000 USD' 条件下, 5/5 Solana AMM 全部 negative EV. NOT '长期所有 LP 都没价值'. 长期判断需要 regime split + actual fee data + larger capital + different strategy.
